title: Window sizes
caption: One chat in a 200K and a 1M window, with the attention spread over what is in it.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: The timeline, the window as a bar with a smart-zone line, and the attention card. Nothing else is switched on.
readme.tryit: Flip the 200K | 1M switch in the window head. Open the ⋯ menu on the Attention card to reshape the distribution or change the list layout.
readme.notice: The same chat fills 64% of 200K and passes the 80K line, but only 13% of 1M, where no line is crossed.
